pattern_explanation: Spanish and English share many roots, so some words look alike on the page, but their meanings have drifted apart over time. Each look-alike pair must be learned as a separate meaning rather than guessed from spelling.
false_friend_warning: Warning: the Spanish word for folder looks like the English word carpet, which means a floor covering, and the Spanish word for soup looks like the English word soap, which is used for washing. Students who trust spelling alone will choose the wrong English word.
